theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W K : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ → IsOpen W → IsCompact K → μ (W \ K) ≠ ∞ → ∀ (θ : Covector (Eucl P) n) (h : Eucl P → ℝ) (c c' : ℝ), (∀ x, |h x| ≤ c) → (∀ x, x ∉ W → h x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ K, h x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |ξ x θ| ≤ c') → ∀ φ : TestFormOn U n, (∀ x, (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x = h x • θ) → |T φ| ≤ c * c' * (μ (W \ K)).toReal
